May 6, 2014

Ann clowned with Avner Eisenberg, Julie Goell, Keith Johnstone,
Karen Montanero, Ruth Zaporah, and Vivian Gladwell.

She had 33 years of teaching in Waldorf and public schools including
teaching Biography to adults and mentoring teachers. She held
an MA in Speech and Theatre from Indiana University.
